title: BetterCombat Particle Enhancements
description: Retextures the particles from BetterCombat Particle to feel snappier & adds weapon color compact for various mods, along other enhancements.
body:
**IMPORTANT NOTE**: 1.21.1 does **NOT** have mod compacts; it only has the retextured particles. This is due to a technical limitation from BC Particle and BetterCombat merging on 1.21.1

## BetterCombat Particle Enhancement + Compact
## 
### Features:


- **All attack particles** are **totally redrawn** with smoothness and clarity in mind - no longer will swinging a sword create a blurry mess on your screen.
  
- The **punching animation** has been modified to better suit what an actual punch would look like, and the **dual-wield stab particle**'s placement has been realigned to match the real animation.

- **Mod compact** is included. High-tier and unique items from various mods have **unique colored particles** to denote their strength and to improve their visuals. Furthermore, some attacks from mods like SimplySwords and SimplyMore do not have particles attached - this pack fixes that.

### List of supported mods: 

- Alex's Caves
- Aquamirae
- Born In Chaos
- Cataclysm
- Cataclysm: Spellbooks
- Celestisynth
- Hazen n' Stuff
- Ice and Fire
- Iron's Spells n' Spellbooks
- Legendary Monsters
- Peyro's Scythe
- Simply Swords
- Simply More
- T.O. Magic and Extras

If there is a mod that you want to see compact for, feel free to ask! No guarantee I will get to it soon though.
